rationale: Derived from paired-20261104-095419-1f8e78f4-v031-drive log analysis: (1) Permanently disables [ECM] 44771 Torque Oscillation Module and sets [ECM] 44776 Row 14 OSCMOD / Anti-Shuffle to 1.000 to eliminate the 12-15 Hz rapid spark chop limit cycle (24 deg <-> 4 deg) observed at 5:38 (t=340s); (2) Confirms [ECM] 44607 Tip-In Torque Control RPM Min raised to 7,500 RPM; (3) Extends [ECM] 44496 DFCO delay from 0.90s to 1.35s to widen the post-lift overrun pop window from ~300ms to ~850ms; (4) Calibrates [ECM] 44605 Spark Decel 3,000 RPM cell to -3.00 deg ATDC (Row 4 & 5) to restore crisp pops across typical 2,800-3,800 RPM driving coast-downs while keeping 4k-6k at -8.00 deg for loud crackles and 2k cushioned at +8.00 deg. Preserves v031 MAF -2.5% cruising trim centering.
